front.title: The "_abiz" Underscored and Globally Scoped DNS Node Name for Agentic Business Records

abstract.t: This document specifies use of the underscored DNS node name "_abiz" with TXT resource records to publish a pointer from a domain to a signed public business record served over HTTPS. It describes discovery and verification of that record and requests registration of the "_abiz" node name and the "abiz.json" well-known URI suffix.
